title: Susitikimas kavinėje
transcriptLt: Labas, Toma! Kur tu esi? Aš jau kavinėje. Labas, Minedai! Būsiu už penkių minučių.
transcriptEn: Hello, Tomas! Where are you? I'm already at the cafe. Hello, Minedas! I'll be there in five minutes.

questions.questionText: Where is Tomas currently waiting?
questions.explanation: Tomas says 'Aš jau kavinėje' which translates to 'I am already in the cafe'.

questions.questionText: When will the other person arrive?
questions.explanation: She responds with 'Būsiu už penkių minučių' (I will be there in five minutes).

title: Kava išsinešimui
transcriptLt: Labas, ar galiu gauti kavos, prašau? Labas! Taip, vietoje ar išsinešimui? Išsinešimui, prašau. Gerai, kokio dydžio? Mažą, ačiū. Gerai, viena sekundė.
transcriptEn: Hi, can I get a coffee, please? Hi! Yes, to stay or to go? To go, please. Okay, what size? Small, thank you. Okay, just a second.

questions.questionText: Does the customer want to drink the coffee at the cafe?
questions.explanation: He asks for 'Išsinešimui, prašau' which means 'To go, please'.

questions.questionText: What size coffee does he ask for?
questions.explanation: He orders 'Mažą, ačiū' (Small, thank you).

title: Didelė juoda kava
transcriptLt: Laba diena, prašau vieną juodą kavą. Laba diena. Gersite čia ar išsinešite? Išsinešimui. Didelę ar mažą? Didelę, ačiū. Tuoj bus!
transcriptEn: Good day, one black coffee please. Good day. Will you drink here or take away? To go. Large or small? Large, thank you. Coming right up!

questions.questionText: What specific kind of coffee is ordered?
questions.explanation: The customer requests 'vieną juodą kavą' (one black coffee).

questions.questionText: Which size does the buyer pick this time?
questions.explanation: He replies with 'Didelę, ačiū' (Large, thank you).

title: Kava su pienu ryte
transcriptLt: Labas rytas! Noriu kavos su pienu, prašau. Labas rytas! Ar gersite vietoje? Ne, išsinešimui. Vidutinio dydžio? Taip, vidutinę. Minutėlę!
transcriptEn: Good morning! I want a coffee with milk, please. Good morning! Will you drink here? No, to go. Medium size? Yes, medium. One minute!

questions.questionText: What addition does the customer want in his coffee?
questions.explanation: He asks for 'kavos su pienu' (coffee with milk).

questions.questionText: What size coffee does the barista suggest and confirm?
questions.explanation: The barista asks 'Vidutinio dydžio?' and he confirms 'Taip, vidutinę' (Yes, medium).

title: Kava čia, vietoje
transcriptLt: Sveiki, ar galima kapučino? Sveiki, taip! Norite čia ar išsinešti? Norėčiau gerti čia. Mažą ar didelį puodelį? Mažą puodelį, ačiū. Prisėskite, tuoj atnešiu.
transcriptEn: Hello, can I have a cappuccino? Hello, yes! Would you like here or to go? I would like to drink here. A small or a large cup? A small cup, thank you. Have a seat, I'll bring it right away.

questions.questionText: Where will the customer drink his cappuccino?
questions.explanation: He says 'Norėčiau gerti čia' (I would like to drink here).

questions.questionText: What does the barista tell the customer to do at the end?
questions.explanation: She tells him 'Prisėskite, tuoj atnešiu' (Have a seat, I will bring it right away).

title: Dvi kavos išsinešimui
transcriptLt: Labasvakaras! Ar galiu gauti dvi kavas? Sveiki! Taip, čia ar išsinešimui? Dvi juodas kavas išsinešimui, prašau. Kokio dydžio? Dvi dideles. Gerai, minutę!
transcriptEn: Good evening! Can I get two coffees? Hello! Yes, here or to go? Two black coffees to go, please. What size? Two large ones. Okay, one minute!

questions.questionText: How many coffees does the customer order?
questions.explanation: He asks for 'dvi kavas' (two coffees).

questions.questionText: What greeting is used at the start?
questions.explanation: The conversation opens with 'Labas vakaras!' (Good evening!).

title: Espreso ir vanduo
transcriptLt: Laba diena, prašau vieną espreso. Laba diena! Norite čia ar išsinešimui? Gersiu čia. Ar norite stiklinės vandens? Taip, ačiū. Momentą!
transcriptEn: Good day, one espresso please. Good day! Would you like here or to go? I'll drink here. Would you like a glass of water? Yes, thank you. Just a moment!

questions.questionText: What drink option does the barista offer in addition?
questions.explanation: She asks 'Ar norite stiklinės vandens?' (Would you like a glass of water?).

questions.questionText: What type of coffee is ordered?
questions.explanation: The customer orders 'vieną espreso' (one espresso).

title: Šalta kava išsinešimui
transcriptLt: Labas! Ar turite šaltos kavos? Labas! Taip, turime. Ar imsite išsinešimui? Taip, išsinešimui. Didelę ar vidutinę? Vidutinę, prašau. Tuoj paruošiu!
transcriptEn: Hi! Do you have iced coffee? Hi! Yes, we do. Will you take it to go? Yes, to go. Large or medium? Medium, please. I'll prepare it right away!

questions.questionText: What kind of coffee does the customer ask for?
questions.explanation: He asks 'Ar turite šaltos kavos?' (Do you have cold/iced coffee?).

questions.questionText: What size iced coffee does he choose?
questions.explanation: He specifies 'Vidutinę, prašau' (Medium, please).

title: Kava ir cukrus
transcriptLt: Sveiki, prašau vieną mažą kavą. Sveiki! Vietoje ar išsinešti? Išsinešimui. Ar reikės cukraus? Ne, be cukraus, ačiū. Gerai, viena sekundė.
transcriptEn: Hello, one small coffee please. Hello! To stay or to go? To go. Will you need sugar? No, without sugar, thank you. Okay, just a second.

questions.questionText: Does the customer want sugar in his coffee?
questions.explanation: He states 'Ne, be cukraus, ačiū' (No, without sugar, thank you).

questions.questionText: What Lithuanian phrase means 'without sugar'?
questions.explanation: 'Be cukraus' literally translates to 'without sugar'.

title: Mokėjimas už kavą
transcriptLt: Labas, noriu vienos vidutinės kavos išsinešimui. Labas! Gerai, trys eurai. Mokėsite kortele ar grynaisiais? Kortele, prašau. Ačiū, gražios dienos!
transcriptEn: Hi, I want one medium coffee to go. Hi! Okay, three euros. Will you pay by card or cash? By card, please. Thank you, have a nice day!

questions.questionText: How much does the coffee cost?
questions.explanation: The barista says 'trys eurai' (three euros).

questions.questionText: How does the customer decide to pay?
questions.explanation: He replies with 'Kortele, prašau' (By card, please).
